OpenElixir-02 1.2, custom firmware for the Erica Synths LXR-02 drum machine: a **DJ filter** on the
performance page, on top of the **uninterrupted playback** from 1.1.

> Tested on hardware by the author. OpenElixir-02 is not official Erica Synths firmware and is not
> affiliated with or approved by Erica Synths. Install it at your own risk.

## New in 1.2: DJ filter

A filter on the final mix of all outputs, right on the performance page next to shuffle:

- **`dj`**: turn it left of the center for a low-pass that closes down to 40 Hz, right of the center
  for a high-pass that opens up to 8 kHz. Around the center it is off. The display shows
  "DJ Filt. Cutoff" with "Off", "LP -xx" or "HP xx".
- **`res`**: resonance, from a flat filter up to a strong peak.
- Smooth sweeps without zipper noise, and no clicks when it switches on or off or changes from
  low-pass to high-pass.
- It filters after the effects and before the limiter, so even a strong resonance peak doesn't clip
  (with the limiter switched off, it clips like the stock mix).
- It isn't saved and starts off after every boot. While it is off, the sound is exactly as before.

## New in 1.1: uninterrupted playback

From 1.1 on, one rule applies to everything in OpenElixir-02: **nothing has a higher priority than the
sound and the sequencer.** Menus, the display, the SD card and MIDI all wait for them, never the other
way round.

While the sequencer runs, these no longer interrupt the audio:

- Turning knobs and the encoder, and working in the config menu.
- Loading kits, also single voices and kits from other projects on the SD card.
- Saving kits, patterns and projects to the SD card.
- Inserting the SD card and saving or loading the settings.

What changed:

- **The DACs can't run dry any more.** The audio is sent to the DACs continuously by the hardware
  instead of being restarted in software after every block. The worst delay in that path dropped from
  up to 103 µs to 17 µs, and no longer matters.
- **No more pauses during SD card access.** Saving a kit used to stop the audio and the sequencer for up
  to 28 ms, loading a kit from another project for about 6 ms. Now the audio keeps being rendered
  while the card is read or written.
- **The display stays out of the way.** Page changes and full screen repaints no longer run in the
  highest-priority interrupt.

## For developers

- CPU meter build (`-DLXR_CPU_METER=ON`): two new pages, timing (DMA callback delay, render wait, ADC
  interrupt load, sequencer tick delay) and stalls (longest pause in rendering and the code address it
  happened at). Switching pages keeps the measurements; SHIFT + MORPH on these pages resets them.

## Also included

Everything from 1.0: freely assignable voice engines (SHIFT + KIT), loading single voices and kits from
any project, the limiter (switchable in the config menu), the safe project save and the stock firmware
fixes. Details: [README](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/blob/v1.2/README.md).

## Installing

1. Download `LXR_OpenElixir-02_V1.2.img` below.
2. Copy it to the top folder of the SD card and delete any other `LXR*.img` files there.
3. Switch the LXR-02 off, insert the card, hold the encoder button and switch it on. Keep holding
   until "LXR Updater" appears.
4. Wait for "Update OK!". The device restarts with the new firmware.

To go back, install the official firmware update from Erica Synths the same way. Kits saved with
OpenElixir-02 keep working there; slots with a different engine play with their stock engine.

The `.hex` and `.elf` files are for programming and debugging with an ST-Link; you don't need them for
a normal update.
